<!-- Code generated by packages/kit-compose/src/organisms.ts from packages/compose-gen/specs (compose-gen organism emitters on kit-compose). DO NOT EDIT. -->
<!--
  An app-style tab bar for a phone: an icon over a label per tab, the current one marked. Axes: labels (show,
  hide: icons only with the name hidden), position (static, sticky: stays at the bottom of the page), tone.
-->
<script lang="ts">
import type { NavLink } from "./nav-bar.types";

export type BottomNavProps = {
  label: string;
  tabs: NavLink[];
  current?: string;
  labels?: "show" | "hide";
  position?: "static" | "sticky";
  tone?: "default" | "muted";
  landmarkLabel?: string;
};
</script>

<script setup lang="ts">
import Block from "../compose/Block.vue";
import Inline from "../compose/Inline.vue";
import List from "../compose/List.vue";
import ListItem from "../compose/ListItem.vue";
import LucideIcon from "../icons/LucideIcon.vue";
import MenuEntry from "../components/menu-entry.vue";
import { cn } from "../utils";

const {
  label,
  tabs,
  current = "",
  labels = "show",
  position = "static",
  tone = "default",
  landmarkLabel,
} = defineProps<BottomNavProps>();
</script>

<template>
  <Block v-if="((tabs?.length ?? 0) > 0)"
    tag="nav"
    :class="cn(
      'mx-auto w-full max-w-md border-t border-border',
      (((tone as string) === 'muted') ? 'bg-muted' : 'bg-background'),
      (((position as string) === 'sticky') ? 'sticky bottom-0 z-40' : '')
    )"
    :aria-label="(landmarkLabel ?? label)"
    :data-position="position"
    data-slot="bottom-nav"
  >
    <List class="m-0 grid list-none grid-flow-col auto-cols-fr p-0" data-slot="items">
      <ListItem v-for="tab in tabs" :key="tab.id" data-slot="tabs-row">
        <MenuEntry
          :href="tab.href"
          :class="cn(
            'flex flex-col items-center gap-2 py-2 text-xs',
            ((tab.id === current) ? 'font-semibold text-primary' : 'text-muted-foreground')
          )"
          :current="(tab.id === current)"
          testid="item"
        >
          <LucideIcon :name="tab.icon" :size="20" />
          <Inline :class="(((labels as string) === 'hide') ? 'sr-only' : '')">
            {{ tab.name }}
          </Inline>
        </MenuEntry>
      </ListItem>
    </List>
  </Block>
</template>
